title: Hardship Assistance Programs: Entry Requirements by Program
content:
Each of the seven Hardship Assistance Programs has its own entry figures. The schedule below gives, for every program, the loan statuses it accepts, the hardship reasons it accepts, the seasoning and payment figures the loan must meet, and the channels through which a request can be made.

## Meaning of each figure

- **Eligible loan statuses**: loan statuses in which the program can be requested.
- **Qualifying reasons**: hardship reasons the program accepts.
- **Minimum months since funding**: whole calendar months the loan must have been funded at the request date.
- **Minimum installments paid**: scheduled installments that must have been paid in full since funding at the request date.
- **Maximum days past due at request**: highest days past due the loan may have at the request date; "not applicable" for programs on charged-off loans.
- **Minimum days since charge-off**: calendar days that must have passed since charge-off; 0 for programs on active loans.
- **Minimum documented income drop**: minimum documented drop in monthly household income versus before the hardship, percent; 0 when not required.
- **Minimum principal balance**: smallest unpaid principal (charged-off balance for settlement) eligible for the program, USD.
- **Request channels**: channels through which the program can be requested.

## Status, reasons and channels

| Program | Eligible loan statuses | Qualifying reasons | Request channels |
|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term Payment Deferral | active | job loss; reduced income; medical hardship; death of a household earner; divorce or separation; other | phone, online, mobile app, mail |
| Reduced Payment Plan | active | job loss; reduced income; medical hardship; death of a household earner; divorce or separation | phone, online, mobile app, mail |
| Temporary Rate Reduction Plan | active | reduced income; medical hardship; death of a household earner; divorce or separation | phone, online, mobile app, mail |
| Term Extension Modification | active | reduced income; medical hardship; death of a household earner; divorce or separation | phone, online, mobile app, mail |
| Disaster Relief Deferral | active | natural disaster | phone, online, mobile app, mail |
| Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit | active or charged off | military service | phone, online, mobile app, mail |
| Charged-Off Settlement Plan | charged off | job loss; reduced income; medical hardship; death of a household earner; divorce or separation; other | phone, online, mobile app, mail |

## Seasoning, payment and balance figures

| Program | Min. months since funding | Min. installments paid | Max. days past due at request | Min. days since charge-off | Min. documented income drop (%) | Min. principal balance (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term Payment Deferral | 3 | 3 | 59 | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Reduced Payment Plan | 3 | 3 | 89 | 0 | 0 | 500.00 |
| Temporary Rate Reduction Plan | 6 | 6 | 89 | 0 | 20 | 1000.00 |
| Term Extension Modification | 12 | 9 | 119 | 0 | 25 | 2000.00 |
| Disaster Relief Deferral | 0 | 0 | 119 | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit | 0 | 0 | 119 | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Charged-Off Settlement Plan | 0 | 0 | not applicable | 30 | 0 | 300.00 |

For the Charged-Off Settlement Plan the minimum balance is measured on the charged-off balance rather than the unpaid principal.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical figures)

- A loan that is 70 days past due on the request date is within the 89-day figure of the Reduced Payment Plan and beyond the 59-day figure of the Short-Term Payment Deferral.
- A loan with 450.00 USD of unpaid principal is below the 500.00 figure of the Reduced Payment Plan; the Short-Term Payment Deferral sets no minimum principal.
- A request giving "other" as its hardship reason is among the qualifying reasons only of the Short-Term Payment Deferral and the Charged-Off Settlement Plan.
